info.title: Relay HTTP API
info.description: Generated from apps/web/app/**/route.ts by scripts/docs-api-check.mjs --write. Do not edit by hand. Only /api/v1/* (API keys) and /mcp are intended for integrations; the other session routes are the web app's own API (cookie session + CSRF) and may change between releases. Request schemas are zod schemas, quoted as source excerpts.

session.name: sl_session
session.description: Opaque session cookie (__Host-sl_session in production). 30 min idle, 12 h absolute.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: csrf_token from GET /api/session; required on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE together with a same-origin Origin header.

get.summary: GET /api/collab/stream?post=<id>&after=<cursor> — Server-Sent Events for one post's collaboration changes plus the call…
get.description:
GET /api/collab/stream?post=<id>&after=<cursor> — Server-Sent Events for one post's collaboration changes plus the caller's own notification events. Small, content-free events ({ id, kind, ref_id }); the client refetches through the normal authorized APIs. Every 15 s the session and access are re-checked: revoked membership, a signed-out session or lost access to the post ends the stream with `event: revoked`. Streams end after ~55 s (`event: end`) and the client reconnects from its last event id, so proxies never hold connections forever. Polling fallback: /api/collab/events.

get.summary: GET /api/inbox/stream?after=<id> — Server-Sent Events for the inbox (stream B;
get.description:
GET /api/inbox/stream?after=<id> — Server-Sent Events for the inbox (stream B; same pattern as /api/collab/stream). Small, content-free events ({ id, conversation_id, kind, at }) for conversations on brands the caller can read; the client refetches through the normal authorized APIs. Every 15 s the session, membership and inbox.read are re-checked: revoked access ends the stream with `event: revoked` (acceptance test 12). Streams end after ~55 s (`event: end`) and the client reconnects from its last id. Polling fallback: /api/inbox/events.

V5 WID — GET /api/widget/session: who the widget talks as (member / visitor), availability ("Send us a message" unless staffed chat is configured), CSRF tokens for this browser's identities, a signed form token, and recent conversations.

post.description:
V5 WID — POST /api/widget/session/end: "End chat on this device" (revokes the visitor session; clears the cookie). Conversations are kept; reopening them on this device needs the emailed one-time code.

Access: Widget. Support widget: a signed-in member session or the widget visitor session cookie; Origin checked.

200.description: Success. JSON body returned by the service (or a redirect/stream where the description says so).

post.summary: V5 WID — POST /api/widget/verify { email }: email a one-time code + link IF that address has widget conversations.

V5 WID — POST /api/widget/verify { email }: email a one-time code + link IF that address has widget conversations. Always answers 202 the same way (no enumeration); rate-limited per IP and per address.

Access: Widget. Support widget: a signed-in member session or the widget visitor session cookie; Origin checked.

200.description: Success. JSON body returned by the service (or a redirect/stream where the description says so).

post.description:
V5 WID — POST /api/widget/verify/confirm { code } | { token }: prove control of the email; this browser session may then see conversations started with it. Never links a user account or workspace.
